member.name: T:LingoHop.Infrastructure.Telegram.TelegramInitDataValidator
member.summary:
Verifies a Telegram Mini App launch payload as described in https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#validating-data-received-via-the-mini-app.
The check is: build a newline-joined key=value string from every field except hash and signature, sorted by key; HMAC-SHA256 it with a secret derived from the bot token; compare against the supplied hash. Only Telegram and the bot owner know the token, so a matching hash proves the payload was not forged or tampered with.
